question: Why did Intel's gross margin fall in 2024?
reference: Gross margin fell to 32.7% on large restructuring/impairment and accelerated-depreciation charges (Intel 7 assets), higher inventory reserves and higher unit costs from new process nodes (Intel 2024 10-K, MD&A).

question: Why did UK inflation spike in 2022?
reference: CPI rose to 11.1% in October 2022, the largest upward contributions from housing and household services (electricity and gas) and food (ONS, Consumer price inflation, October 2022).

question: Why did Nvidia's revenue jump in fiscal 2024?
reference: Revenue rose 126% to $60.9B, led by Data Center (+217%) on demand for Hopper GPUs for large language models (NVIDIA FY2024 10-K). Because has no segment data, so only 'demand-led' is checkable.

question: Why did US unemployment spike in 2020?
reference: Unemployment jumped to 14.7% in April 2020 as COVID-19 shutdowns cut 20.5M payroll jobs, with leisure and hospitality down 7.7M (BLS Employment Situation, April 2020).

question: Why did Meta's net income drop in 2022?
reference: Net income fell 41%: revenue declined 1% while costs and expenses rose 22% (Reality Labs R&D, headcount, $4.6B restructuring charges) (Meta Q4/FY2022 results; 2022 10-K).

question: Why did Tesla's gross margin fall in 2023?
reference: Automotive gross margin fell mainly on lower average selling prices after price reductions across models (Tesla 2023 10-K, MD&A).

question: Why did Apple's revenue decline in fiscal 2023?
reference: Net sales fell 3% on lower Mac and iPad sales and a stronger US dollar, partly offset by Services (Apple FY2023 10-K, MD&A).

question: Why did Microsoft's net income fall in fiscal 2023?
reference: Net income slipped 1% as operating expenses grew (R&D, plus a Q2 charge for severance, hardware portfolio changes and lease consolidation) faster than gross margin (Microsoft FY2023 10-K).

question: Why did Nvidia's net income jump in fiscal 2024?
reference: Net income rose to $29.8B from $4.4B on revenue growth and gross margin expansion to 72.7% (NVIDIA FY2024 10-K).

question: Why did Tesla's net income fall in 2024?
reference: Net income fell 53% mainly because 2023 included a one-time $5.9B non-cash tax benefit from releasing a valuation allowance; operating income also fell on lower vehicle prices (Tesla 2024 10-K).

question: Why did Intel's net income fall in 2024?
reference: Net loss of $18.8B: a non-cash charge to establish a valuation allowance on US deferred tax assets, restructuring and impairment charges, and lower gross margin (Intel 2024 10-K).

question: Why did Intel's revenue fall in 2023?
reference: Revenue fell 14% on weaker PC and server demand (customer inventory digestion) across CCG and DCAI (Intel 2023 10-K).

question: Why did UK inflation fall in 2023?
reference: CPI fell from 10.5% (Dec 2022) to 3.9% (Nov 2023); housing and household services (energy) inflation turned negative, motor fuel prices fell and food inflation eased from 19.2% in March (ONS, Consumer price inflation, November 2023).

question: Why did US inflation rise in 2021?
reference: CPI-U rose 7.0% over 2021; energy +29.3% and used cars and trucks +37.3% were among the largest increases (BLS CPI, December 2021).

question: Why did US inflation fall in 2023?
reference: CPI-U inflation fell from 6.5% (Dec 2022) to 3.4% (Dec 2023); the energy index declined over the year (BLS CPI, December 2023).

question: Why did UK unemployment rise in 2009?
reference: Unemployment rose to about 8% during the 2008-09 recession that followed the global financial crisis, as output fell (ONS labour market statistics; GDP fell about 4% in 2009).

question: Why did US unemployment rise in 2009?
reference: Unemployment rose to 10.2% in October 2009 as first published (10.0% after revisions), with payrolls still falling and the largest job losses in construction, manufacturing and retail (BLS Employment Situation, October 2009).
